up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2176942'. For each molecule, provide the following information: ChEMBL ID (the molecule's ChEMBL identifier), preferred name (if available), maximum clinical phase, molecule type (e.g., Small molecule, Antibody), and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2176942'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
